units.source_text: 夕暮天色阴沉，冷雨霏霏。

en.t: At dusk the sky was gloomy, and a cold rain fell in fine, steady drops.

units.source_text: 朔风凛冽，落木萧萧，其音凄凉无比。

en.t: The north wind was bitterly cold, and the sound of falling leaves rustling down was unbearably desolate.

units.source_text: 大女公子躺在床上，历历回思往事，缅想将来，其神情异常优雅。

en.t: The elder young lady lay on her bed, vividly recalling the past and thinking far ahead to the future, her expression extraordinarily graceful.
She was wearing a white robe.

units.source_text: 头发虽然久不梳理，但一丝不乱，光艳可鉴。

en.t: Although her hair had not been combed for a long time, not a strand was out of place, and it shone with a mirrorlike gloss.

units.source_text: 日来久病，脸色略带苍白，反而更增清丽。

en.t: Because she had been ill for so long, her face was slightly pale, which only made her seem even more pure and lovely.

units.source_text: 那含愁凝睇的美容，应请知情识趣者来鉴赏。

en.t: That beautiful face, gazing fixedly with sorrow in it, was something that ought to be appreciated by someone who truly understood feeling and refinement.

units.source_text: 昼寝的那人被狂乱的风声惊醒，坐起身来。

en.t: The one who had been napping was startled awake by the wild roar of the wind and sat up.

units.source_text: 她身穿棣棠色和淡紫色的衣衫，色彩非常鲜丽。

en.t: She was dressed in robes of bright yellow and pale purple, their colors exceptionally vivid.

units.source_text: 两颊微红，仿佛染着胭脂，容颜实甚娇艳，全无半点愁容。

en.t: Her cheeks were faintly flushed, as if touched with rouge; her face was truly charming and radiant, without the slightest trace of sorrow.

units.source_text: 她对姐姐说：“我适才梦见父亲，他满面愁容，在这里环顾四周。”

en.t: She said to her elder sister, "Just now I dreamed of Father; his face was full of sorrow, and he was looking all around here."

units.source_text: 大女公子更加悲伤，说道：“自从父亲亡后，我常想在梦中拜见，岂知一次也不曾见过。”

en.t: The elder young lady grew still more sorrowful and said, "Ever since Father died, I have often wished to see him in my dreams, but I have never seen him even once."
Then the two of them faced each other and wept.

units.source_text: 大女公子想：“近来我日夜思念父亲，或许他的灵魂在这里徬徨，亦未可知。

en.t: The elder young lady thought, "Lately I have been thinking of Father day and night; perhaps his spirit is wandering here, for all I know.
I very much want to go to where he is.

units.source_text: 但我等罪孽深重，不知是否能去。”

en.t: But our sins are deep and heavy, and I do not know whether we will be able to go there."

units.source_text: 她竟在计虑后世之事了。

en.t: She had even begun to ponder matters of the life to come.

units.source_text: 她很想得到中国古代的返魂香。

en.t: She longed to obtain the ancient Chinese incense that could summon back the soul.
